recentItems.title: "Hooray for Hollywood" - Richard W. Whiting - U.S. Marine Band
recentItems.description:
"The President’s Own” United States Marine Band presents "Hooray for Hollywood," by Richard W. Whiting, arranged by John Williams. Directed by Col. Jason K. Fettig, USMC (Ret.), former director. 

From the album "John Williams and 'The President's Own,' Vol. 3" released in 2026.

recentItems.title: Honorary Marine Enlistment & Remarks - The Marines' Hymn - U.S. Marine Band
recentItems.description:
On July 16, 2023, Maestro John Williams was given the title of Honorary Marine. He was awarded the title by former Commandant of the Marine Corps, General David H. Berger, and then-Assistant Commandant of the Marine Corps General Eric M. Smith presented the title. From the album "John Williams and 'The President's Own,' Vol. 3" released in 2026.
